BUSINESS OVERVIEW OF BUSINESS We were founded in 1846 and incorporated in Delaware in 1925. We develop, manufacture and market a broad range of consumer household and personal care products and specialty products focused on animal and food production, chemicals and cleaners. Our well-recognized brands include ARM & HAMMER® baking soda, cat litter, laundry detergent, carpet deodorizer and other baking soda-based products; OXICLEAN® stain removers, cleaning solutions, laundry detergents and bleach alternatives; BATISTE® dry shampoo; WATERPIK® water flossers; THERABREATH® oral care products; HERO® acne treatment products; TOUCHLAND® hand sanitizers; TROJAN® condoms, lubricants and vibrators; FIRST RESPONSE® home pregnancy and ovulation test kits; NAIR® depilatories; ORAJEL® oral analgesic; XTRA® laundry detergent; and ZICAM® cold shortening and relief products. Seven of those brands are designated as "power brands" because they compete in large categories, and we believe they have the potential for significant global expansion. Those seven brands are ARM & HAMMER®; OXICLEAN®; BATISTE®; WATERPIK®; THERABREATH®; HERO® and TOUCHLAND® and represent approximately 70% of our net sales and profits. Prior to the sale of our VITAFUSION® and L'IL CRITTERS® (“VMS”) business at the end of 2025, we included VMS as an eighth “power brand.” We sell our consumer products under a variety of brands through a broad distribution platform that includes supermarkets, mass merchandisers, wholesale clubs, drugstores, convenience stores, home stores, dollar and other discount stores, pet and other specialty stores and websites and other e-commerce channels, all of which sell our products to consumers. We sell our specialty products to industrial customers, livestock producers and through distributors. credit_strengths.text: Gross leverage sits well below the sector median and improved year over year, reflecting steady debt reduction against a growing EBITDA base. Net leverage also remains below the sector median and comfortably inside the next risk-band boundary, leaving meaningful headroom before any profile migration.

Operating margin expanded year over year and exceeds the sector median, supported by the power-brand portfolio that drives most net sales and profits. Interest coverage and EBITDA coverage both improved and stand far above sector medians, indicating substantial capacity to absorb rate or earnings volatility.

key_risks.text: Free cash flow falls short of combined dividends and buybacks, so distributions are partly funded from balance-sheet capacity rather than internally generated cash. Shareholder returns absorb essentially all operating cash flow, leaving thin residual cushion for acquisitions or unexpected working-capital swings.

The debt stack is entirely fixed-rate senior notes with a meaningful tranche maturing in the near term, requiring refinancing in a higher-rate environment; the remainder is laddered into the next decade. Commercial paper capacity exists as a backstop but was undrawn, so short-term funding reliance is currently low.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating income covers gross interest expense many times over, and EBITDA coverage is similarly strong and above the sector median. Cash flow to debt and free cash flow to debt both exceed sector medians and improved year over year, indicating robust debt-servicing capacity from recurring consumer-staples cash generation.

Liquidity is adequate rather than ample: the current ratio exceeds the sector median but declined sharply year over year, and cash balances are modest relative to total debt. Capital expenditure is light relative to operating cash flow, so internal funding of maturities appears feasible absent a large acquisition.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, anchored by leverage below sector medians and strong coverage. Our judgement is that the issuer retains headroom against the next leverage and cash-flow boundaries, though the cushion is narrower on a net-debt basis and would erode under a moderate EBITDA decline.

We view the credit as stable but watch distribution policy: buybacks consume most free cash flow, and the near-term note maturity introduces refinancing sensitivity. Continued operating margin strength and disciplined capital allocation would preserve the current profile; a shift toward debt-funded returns or acquisitions would be the key negative trigger.

credit_strengths.text: 總槓桿率遠低於行業中位數，並按年改善，反映在EBITDA基礎持續增長下債務穩步減少。淨槓桿率亦維持低於行業中位數，並穩處於下一個風險區間邊界之內，在評級狀況任何遷移前留有顯著緩衝空間。
營業利潤率按年擴大並高於行業中位數，由帶動大部分淨銷售及利潤的動力品牌組合支撐。利息覆蓋率及EBITDA覆蓋率均有所改善，並遠高於行業中位數，顯示具備雄厚能力吸收利率或盈利波動。

key_risks.text: 自由現金流不足以覆蓋股息與回購的合計金額，故分派部分由資產負債表能力而非內部產生現金支持。股東回報基本上吸納全部經營現金流，為收購或意外營運資金波動留下的剩餘緩衝薄弱。
債務結構全為固定利率優先票據，其中一筆具規模的批次於短期內到期，需在較高利率環境下再融資；其餘則分散於未來十年內到期。商業票據額度作為後備存在但並未動用，故目前對短期融資的依賴程度較低。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營業利潤對總利息費用的覆蓋倍數甚高，EBITDA覆蓋率同樣強勁並高於行業中位數。現金流對債務比率及自由現金流對債務比率均高於行業中位數並按年改善，顯示來自經常性消費必需品現金產生的穩健償債能力。
流動性屬足夠而非充裕：流動比率高於行業中位數但按年大幅下降，且現金結餘相對總債務而言規模有限。資本開支相對經營現金流而言較輕，故在沒有大型收購的情況下，以內部資金應付到期債務似乎可行。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，以槓桿率低於行業中位數及強勁覆蓋率為錨。我們的判斷是發行人相對於下一個槓桿及現金流邊界仍保有緩衝，惟按淨債務基礎計算緩衝較窄，並會在EBITDA中度下降下受到侵蝕。
我們認為該信貸狀況穩定，但關注分派政策：回購消耗大部分自由現金流，而短期票據到期帶來再融資敏感度。營業利潤率持續強勁及資本配置紀律將可維持目前狀況；轉向以債務支持的股東回報或收購將為主要負面觸發因素。
